text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I'm good! I gave it everything I had right now!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, feeling great! If I keep running like this, it'll be good.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Yukino Bijin-chan even cuter in person
than she is on TV?!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Her skin is totally snow-white! Beyond warm tone or cool tone!
...B-But still.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Wasn't there... an incredible girl out there?
Like, super intense or something...
Harpuia Alpha-chan, was it?"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I know. Races really are incredible.
...Though I'm still on Team Cute Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...That really is amazin'.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I... too...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: —I mean, it's my first time watching a race broadcast, but the 'Snow Angel' is seriously so cute!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, I kind of want to see it in person.
...

text_block_list.name: Passersby A & B
text_block_list.text:
Let's go check out
the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha. Today's run
wasn't bad. However... you understand, right?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: "You have the talent to surpass everything. Your run in the Oaks will raise our expectations even higher, won't it?"

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
...I'll just run my own race.
The results will naturally follow after that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
As long as you understand, that's fine.
...Let's go. We need to formulate our next strategy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...So she's a
'City Girl' too, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like all the fans were
completely captivated by her running, too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even before the race, she was completely dignified the whole time.
She looked super, super cool.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Me too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I want to surprise everyone,
just like she does."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna make everyone think, "Yukino Bijin's running is downright amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back when I debuted, I didn't have the skills, and I honestly thought it'd be tough for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, right now, I feel like I can do it!
choice_data_list: Let's show them what you're made of at the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Our next target race is the second leg of the Tiara route, the Yushun Himba (Oaks).
I know Yukino Bijin will deliver a truly spectacular result.
choice_data_list: (Still... I wonder if she'll be okay.)

text_block_list.text:
What the reporters wanted from Yukino Bijin at the press conference.
And what she herself seeks now—
It felt like there was a gap between the two.
